reason: E4 directly shows graphene interfaces block dislocations and cracks in CoCrFeNi/graphene composites, supporting the core premise. E1 shows dislocation blocking by planar slip bands in a bulk HEA, providing indirect support for barrier effects. However, no cited evidence addresses creep or time-dependent deformation in HEA-graphene systems (E2 discusses creep in a different context without graphene), and the integration into carbon-doped coatings is not demonstrated.

Blocking dislocations delays time-dependent plastic deformation (creep)
